name: Bačice (Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:1:1, with a white five-petalled flower with yellow centre in each blue stripe at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 18 March 2003 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
